translations.web: “Go up on her walls, and destroy; but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not Yahweh’s.
translations.bsb: Go up through her vineyards and ravage them, but do not finish them off. Strip off her branches, for they do not belong to the LORD.
translations.kjv: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not the LORD'S.
translations.asv: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her branches; for they are not Jehovah's.
